supported_scope: Viewing subagent progress and status, inspecting detailed subagent thoughts and logs, reviewing workspace and conversation diffs, adding inline comments to steer the agent, terminating subagents to stop work
unestablished_scope: Limits on interrupting ongoing actions beyond manual termination
Redirecting work outside of inline comment steering
required_setup: No special setup required; use /agents to monitor and control subagents, /diff to review and comment on changes, and keyboard shortcuts for navigation and control
constraints: Manual termination of subagents requires user selection and keypress (K)
Steering via comments requires submitting feedback in /diff Detail View
Inspection requires navigating interactive TUI panels (/agents, /diff)

evidence.section: Agents command (/agents) > Subagent monitoring and control > Inspecting subagent progress
evidence.quote: Highlight a specific subagent row and press Enter to open the full-screen Subagent Detail View . This view displays the subagent’s complete internal thoughts, tool calls, and execution stdout.
evidence.claim: Supports detailed inspection of subagent progress and internal state

evidence.section: Agents command (/agents) > Subagent monitoring and control > Terminating active subagents
evidence.quote: Open /agents and highlight the running subagent row. Press K to terminate the active subagent and all its child threads.
evidence.claim: Supports manual termination of subagents to stop agent work

evidence.section: Diff command (/diff) > Step-by-step walkthrough > Adding comments and steering the agent
evidence.quote: While in the Detail View , you can review the code and write feedback directly onto specific lines: ... Your comments are formatted and sent to the agent as your next prompt, allowing you to steer its next turn.
evidence.claim: Supports inline commenting to steer the agent's next actions

evidence.section: Diff command (/diff) > Interactive diff viewer panels > Navigation and controls
evidence.quote: The diff viewer operates in three modes, which you can cycle through using Tab (or → / ← arrow keys): VCS mode, Turn mode, Commit mode.
evidence.claim: Supports viewing progress and diffs in multiple interactive modes
